'''September 2000 Williston Park tournament (9 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, NY on 9 September 2000. [[Matt Ehrhart]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1210">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-williston-park-ny-9-9-00d1210/ williston-park-ny-9-9-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 9 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-williston-park-ny-9-9-00d1210/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]
